responsibility: Implements SSA liveness analysis and SSA partition management used primarily by out-of-SSA and coalescing. It owns var_map creation and partition union/view logic, computes live-on-entry and live-on-exit bitmaps for SSA partitions over functions or loop regions, supports queries for live variables at statements, and provides verification and dumping utilities that feed the conflict graph and partitioning logic in tree-ssa-coalesce.cc.
same_name_distinction: This file implements SSA liveness computation and var_map/partition management, including building and maintaining partition views, calculating live ranges, and dumping or verifying liveness data used by coalescing and out-of-SSA. In contrast, gcc/tree-ssa-live.h is the declaration layer for those data structures and accessors.
